|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V9-D-jedhajedhacity-2022-07-10-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V9-D-jedhajedhacity-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V9-D-jedhajedhacity-2022-07-10-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V9-D-jedhajedhacity.gif]], 10 July 2022).
